justifications.D1: "a permutation-calibrated threshold is the only way this design adds information beyond the existing run" — construction-induced similarity is treated as the default and the permutation null is made a hard promotion requirement (F4a), with orthogonal-split replication required before anything exceeds PENDING.
justifications.D3: "F2... if the L-function-zeros catalog contributes zero Tier-1 cross-domain buckets... the sub-hypothesis... is falsified" — a cheap, early, mechanism-independent falsifier plus numeric F1/F3/F4 and a no-retuning stopping rule.
justifications.D4: "shuffle catalog labels... 1,000 times... a candidate must exceed the 99th percentile of this null" — each summary confound has a concrete null (Benford, range-matched, prime-conditioned, non-lineage), but there is no known-anchor positive control demonstrating the pipeline can detect a real bridge.
justifications.D5: "adding a catalog largely absent from the prior run (L-function zeros)... either outcome is diagnostic of whether the... 'two-tier, no-signal-above-null' finding generalizes to a fifth catalog" — explicit new-cell framing against the already-run pipeline.
justifications.D6: "a null result here is itself the deliverable (per F1), not a reason to keep adjusting the pipeline" — every branch is pre-committed, including 'lost pairs' counting and labeling untested structural matches as untested rather than surviving.

justifications.D1: "the prior runs of this program found (b) every time a formal null was applied. This revival treats that as the base rate to beat, not a warm-up finding" — silence-as-default with the null-vs-chance gap check built to detect a vacuous null (the exact prior disqualification mode).
justifications.D3: "if the density-marginal control alone... already reduces the entire top-K list to below-null... the whole cycle reported as REFUTED without running the shuffled-label null" — a cheap early futility falsifier plus Holm-corrected numeric gates, a program-level kill, and a fixed stop.
justifications.D4: "if the pipeline reports a 'hit' on a cell already established as H=0 / 0-hits, the pipeline is broken, not the hypothesis" — extensive confound isolation (density marginal, prime detrending, stratification, identity key), but the specificity anchor is not paired with a gated known-positive recovery check.
justifications.D5: "the native-vocabulary complement arm is mandatory before any negative claim" — defensible extensions (fourth catalog, native arm, null-gap check) over acknowledged prior kills, but no explicit statement of the new empirical cell.
justifications.D6: "Falsified as VACUOUS if any candidate meets (2)'s p-value but fails the null-gap check... reported prominently, not filed silently" — every branch maps to a named verdict (ARTIFACT, CONFIRMED_KNOWN, REFUTED-for-this-vocabulary, program-level kill).

justifications.D1: "a generic, catalog-agnostic feature-vector similarity metric... will instead reproduce the already-demonstrated 'feature geometry, not object-level coupling' artifact" — every prior kill is rebuilt as an executable control or calibration anchor (marginal-shuffle control, corrected null, Stage-0 anchors).
justifications.D3: "F5 — anchor-recovery falsifier. Positive anchor recovered at <95%... OR negative anchor returns any nonzero hit at 10^-40 tolerance: VOID the run" — a cheap Stage-0 mechanism-independent falsifier plus numeric F1-F7 and terminal ABANDON stopping bars.
justifications.D4: "Recover two known anchors through the exact same similarity-ranking pipeline" — every summary confound addressed by a named control (corrected null, marginal shuffle, prime stratification, dedup, SVD ban) plus explicit positive- and negative-control gates.
justifications.D5: "reframed the hypothesis from 'will feature-vector similarity find bridges' to... a generic-vs-native split" — states the new cell it tests (native vs generic feature vocabularies over four catalogs including zeros) relative to the prior kills.
justifications.D6: "pairs with no such candidate are marked UNTESTABLE and excluded from Stage 1, not silently scored" — every branch is pre-committed (VACUOUS cells, feature-geometry kill, UNTESTABLE, dedup-zero, terminal REDESIGN).

justifications.D1: "the McMullen K3 construction... serves as a negative anchor to certify that the pipeline can produce zero when the ground truth is zero" — silence is the expected default and construction-induced signal is detectable via the mandatory corrected null and marginal-shuffle kill (F3).
justifications.D3: "Stage 0 failures are terminal... ABORT entire run. Do not redesign; ABANDON this arm" — a cheap, early, mechanism-independent anchor falsifier plus numeric F1-F7 with Holm correction and per-cell stopping rules.
justifications.D4: "Positive anchor: EC quadratic twist (900 test curves, 12 isogeny classes) → expect >=4,000 relations, >=95% LMFDB-recorded after class dedup" — full confound coverage (corrected null, marginal shuffle, prime stratification, dedup) plus gated positive and negative controls.
justifications.D5: "Scope reduction: Three catalog pairs only" — a defensibly extended, better-nulled rerun over territory the priors largely settle (generic-fail, feature geometry), without an explicit statement of the new empirical cell it fills.
justifications.D6: "Generic arm finds nothing at all... a valid (falsifying) result, not a failed experiment" — every branch maps to a pre-committed verdict (VACUOUS, FEATURE_GEOMETRY, VOID, zero-novel-discoveries).
